essence: The hall-house is set by the three-part measure in the rudra portion.
The broken mansion takes one part while the remaining parts are equal.
The hall-house in the sun portion is set by the pair-part measure.
The broken mansion is set by portion, and the rest are equal.
The womb is held as a part within the thirteen-part expansion.
